svg.aria-label: Sam Rivera. I build developer tools and the odd piece of creative software — mostly around making a complicated thing legible before making it faster. Away from the editor: film photography, long walks, and whatever I am curious about next. Currently exploring: Local-first software, Type systems, Data visualisation, Bitmap type. Human judgment stays in the loop. Build the tool you keep wishing existed.
